sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》

sentences.en: Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hi, may I speak with Jack?
sentences.zh: 你好，请问杰克在吗？

sentences.en: Hi, Jack.
sentences.zh: 你好，杰克。

sentences.en: My name's Taylor.
sentences.zh: 我叫泰勒。

sentences.en: I'm just calling from the Siena College Research Institute.
sentences.zh: 我是锡耶纳学院研究所的，特此致电。

sentences.en: We're just speaking briefly today to voters in your area.
sentences.zh: 我们今天只是简单地与你们地区的选民进行交流。

sentences.en: No one will try to sell you anything.
sentences.zh: 没人会向你推销任何东西。

sentences.en: Have I reached you on a landline or a cell phone?
sentences.zh: 请问我打的是座机还是手机？

sentences.en: Do you have time to take a survey?
sentences.zh: 你有时间参加一项调查吗？

sentences.en: It just takes about 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 只需要大约10分钟。

sentences.en: Okay, are you sure?
sentences.zh: 好的，你确定吗？

sentences.en: It's very important.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。

sentences.en: Okay, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Now, if the 2020 U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果2020年美国

sentences.en: presidential election was held today, who would you vote for if the candidates were Joe Biden or Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 总统大选在今天举行，如果候选人是乔·拜登或唐纳德·特朗普，你会投给谁？

sentences.en: The Times conducts a major new poll that tackles the biggest questions of the 2020 presidential race.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》进行了一项重大的新民调，旨在解决2020年总统竞选中的重大问题。

sentences.en: And now for the next set of questions, tell me which of the two Democrats you'd be likelier to support for...
sentences.zh: 现在进行下一组问题，告诉我你更倾向于支持哪位民主党人……

sentences.en: How likely is Donald
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump to be re-elected?
sentences.zh: 特朗普连任的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: And which Democrat is best positioned to defeat him?
sentences.zh: 哪位民主党人最有优势击败他？

sentences.en: It's Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 今天是星期二，

sentences.en: November 5th.
Nate Cohn, this morning, The Times released this poll that you have been working on that's, as best I can tell, the biggest poll The Times has done in the 2020 campaign.
sentences.zh: 内特·科恩，今天早上《纽约时报》发布了你参与制作的这份民调，据我所知，这是《纽约时报》在2020年竞选期间所做的规模最大的一次民调。

sentences.en: What is the story of this particular poll?
sentences.zh: 这份民调背后的故事是什么？

sentences.en: I think we decided to pursue this project for two main reasons.
sentences.zh: 我想我们决定开展这个项目主要有两个原因。

sentences.en: The first is because of electability.
sentences.zh: 第一个原因是关于胜选能力。

sentences.en: Polls show that Democrats are obsessed with how to beat the president.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，民主党人非常执着于如何击败现任总统。

sentences.en: They say that they would rather vote for a candidate who they thought had the best chance to beat
sentences.zh: 他们说，比起在议题上最认同的候选人，他们更愿意投票给他们认为最有机会击败

sentences.en: President Trump, even more so than someone who they agree with most on the issues.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的候选人。

sentences.en: And we thought that was an issue that we didn't know very much about, that we didn't have very much data that could
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是一个我们了解不多、数据不足的问题，无法

sentences.en: address that question of what kinds of candidates, what kinds of issues, what kinds of messages are likeliest to have an advantage in the general election.
sentences.zh: 回答什么样的候选人、什么样的议题、什么样的信息最有可能在大选中占据优势。

sentences.en: The second reason is because in the last election, the polls, you know, basically got it wrong.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是，在上一次选举中，民调基本上搞错了。

sentences.en: The national polls were okay.
sentences.zh: 全国性民调还算可以。

sentences.en: They showed
sentences.zh: 它们显示

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton ahead.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿领先。

sentences.en: And indeed, she won the national vote.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她确实赢得了全国普选票。

sentences.en: But the election was decided in a series of battleground states where the polls showed Hillary Clinton with a wide advantage.
sentences.zh: 但选举结果是由一系列摇摆州决定的，而这些州的民调显示希拉里·克林顿拥有巨大优势。

sentences.en: Now to decision 2016 coverage tonight and the push for Pennsylvania, which will be a key battleground state.
sentences.zh: 现在回到今晚的2016年大选报道，以及对宾夕法尼亚州——这个关键摇摆州的争夺。

sentences.en: They showed almost across the board that Hillary Clinton would defeat Donald
sentences.zh: 它们几乎全面显示希拉里·克林顿将击败唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton is holding a nine point lead over.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿领先九个百分点。

sentences.en: Trailing Hillary Clinton by about seven points.
sentences.zh: 落后希拉里·克林顿约七个百分点。

sentences.en: Clinton ahead, 46 percent to 36 percent for Trump.
sentences.zh: 克林顿以46%对36%领先特朗普。

sentences.en: When you're losing that bad in all the swing states after the conventions, not to put too fine a point on it, but if you're a presidential candidate, you have to change that.
sentences.zh: 当你在党代会后在所有摇摆州都输得这么惨时，说得直白点，如果你是总统候选人，你必须改变这种状况。

sentences.en: That's an emergency.
sentences.zh: 这是紧急情况。

sentences.en: And those polls were wrong for a number of reasons.
sentences.zh: 那些民调出错的原因有很多。

sentences.en: I think the biggest reason is because they underrepresented the number of white voters without a college degree.
sentences.zh: 我认为最大的原因是它们低估了没有大学学历的白人选民人数。

sentences.en: That's the president's base.
sentences.zh: 那是总统的基本盘。

sentences.en: But the polls that were conducted in these critical states tended to drastically underestimate the number of white working class voters who are part of the electorate.
sentences.zh: 但在这些关键州进行的民调往往严重低估了作为选民一部分的白人工人阶级选民的人数。

sentences.en: Why would that be?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: In general, well-educated voters are likeliest to respond to political surveys.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，受过良好教育的选民最有可能回应政治调查。

sentences.en: That's been true for a long time.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经持续很长时间了。

sentences.en: But many state pollsters, unlike the national polls, I should note, did not adjust for that, which had significant consequences for the overall result.
sentences.zh: 但许多州级民调机构——我应该指出，这与全国性民调不同——并没有对此进行调整，这给最终结果带来了严重后果。

sentences.en: And so in order to accomplish those two goals, we knew that we had to conduct surveys in
sentences.zh: 因此，为了实现这两个目标，我们知道必须在

sentences.en: the six closest states that were carried by the president, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Florida,
sentences.zh: 总统获胜的六个最接近的州进行调查：宾夕法尼亚州、威斯康星州、密歇根州、佛罗里达州、

sentences.en: Arizona, and North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州和北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: And we got an Iowa bonus on the side.
sentences.zh: 我们还顺便做了一个爱荷华州的民调。

sentences.en: And we asked voters of all parties whether they would vote for Donald Trump or one of the three leading Democratic candidates in head-to-head
sentences.zh: 我们询问了各党派选民，在面对面的对决中，他们会投票给唐纳德·特朗普还是三位领先的民主党候选人中的哪一位，

sentences.en: matchups, Joe Biden, Bernie Sanders, and Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 即乔·拜登、伯尼·桑德斯和伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: And we had to make sure that we did an appropriate job of representing the groups at the site of the last election.
sentences.zh: 我们必须确保在代表上次选举现场的群体方面做得恰当。

sentences.en: And we also asked them about their views on a range of issues.
sentences.zh: 我们还询问了他们对一系列议题的看法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Our colleague, Daily Producer Jessica Chung, actually went up to Siena to watch holing in action for this actual project.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事，《每日新闻》制片人杰西卡·钟实际上去了锡耶纳，观察了这个项目的实际民调过程。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Jess.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是杰西。

sentences.en: I'm a producer with The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《每日新闻》的制片人。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I was wondering if I could ask you a few questions.
sentences.zh: 我想问你几个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that call center is in the basement of a dormitory.
sentences.zh: 那个呼叫中心在宿舍的地下室里。

sentences.en: Well, my name's Taylor Buckingham, and I work for the Siena College Research Institute, and I'm currently a second semester senior.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我叫泰勒·白金汉，我在锡耶纳学院研究所工作，目前是大四下学期。

sentences.en: I'm Connor McCann, and I'm doing Siena College
sentences.zh: 我是康纳·麦肯，我正在做锡耶纳学院

sentences.en: Research Institute polling.
sentences.zh: 研究所的民调工作。

sentences.en: My name is Jim Campagna.
sentences.zh: 我叫吉姆·坎帕尼亚。

sentences.en: I'm a retired New York State Department of Taxation and Finance worker, and I'm doing this job at Siena.
sentences.zh: 我是一名退休的纽约州税务和财政部员工，我正在锡耶纳做这份工作。

sentences.en: It's a part-time gig.
sentences.zh: 这是一份兼职工作。

sentences.en: The interviewers who are placing these telephone calls are a mix of students and retirees and people who make these calls as their second job.
sentences.zh: 负责拨打这些电话的采访员由学生、退休人员和把这当作第二职业的人组成。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Is this not Jeanette?
sentences.zh: 这不是珍妮特吗？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢。

sentences.en: They might spend all day trying to reach only a handful of respondents who actually pick up the phone and complete our survey.
sentences.zh: 他们可能花了一整天时间，才联系到少数几个真正接听电话并完成我们调查的受访者。

sentences.en: And what number call was that?
sentences.zh: 那是第几个电话？

sentences.en: That was number 32.
sentences.zh: 那是第32个。

sentences.en: And how many did you complete?
sentences.zh: 你完成了多少个？

sentences.en: Two so far.
sentences.zh: 目前两个。

sentences.en: I've called people about 200 calls in two hours, and I will get no surveys.
sentences.zh: 我两小时内打了大约200个电话，一个调查都没完成。

sentences.en: 23, and I've got one.
sentences.zh: 23个，我完成了一个。

sentences.en: That was 88.
sentences.zh: 那是第88个。

sentences.en: I finally got one.
sentences.zh: 我终于完成了一个。

sentences.en: Not bad.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: I think I had 130 attempts in two hours, and that was my sixth successful call.
sentences.zh: 我想我在两小时内尝试了130次，那是我的第六个成功电话。

sentences.en: Oh, great.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, listening to the tape that Jess got from that call center, it is striking just how hard it is to poll people.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听了杰西从那个呼叫中心录下的录音，你会发现进行民调是多么困难。

sentences.en: I mean, logistically, just a huge challenge to get people to answer the phone and then actually answer the questions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从后勤上讲，让人们接听电话并真正回答问题是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I would guess we made several hundred thousand telephone calls in order to get the 5,000 respondents that we ultimately received.
sentences.zh: 我猜我们打了好几十万个电话，才最终得到了5000名受访者。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It feels like just about the most inefficient operation in the universe.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是世界上效率最低的操作。

sentences.en: It has to be.
sentences.zh: 肯定是这样。

sentences.en: And it's gotten much more difficult over the last few years.
sentences.zh: 而且在过去几年里，情况变得更加困难了。

sentences.en: Do you think tone matters when you pick up the phone and call people?
sentences.zh: 你认为当你拿起电话给别人打电话时，语气重要吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: You don't want to, they tell you that, like, you don't want to sound like a robot.
sentences.zh: 你不想，他们会告诉你，你不想听起来像个机器人。

sentences.en: And like, sometimes it's hard to because you're reading off a screen.
sentences.zh: 而且有时候这很难，因为你是照着屏幕念。

sentences.en: A stream of robocallers, you know, deters everybody from picking up unknown numbers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一连串的自动呼叫让每个人都害怕接听陌生号码。

sentences.en: You know, hello, like, you know, it's kind of, we're just, I'm not selling you anything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，喂，就像，你知道，我们只是，我不是在向你推销任何东西。

sentences.en: I'm just doing a poll today.
sentences.zh: 我今天只是在做一个民调。

sentences.en: Otherwise, if you do with the robot voice, they usually just hang up or you get like a pretty vulgar hang up or something like that.
sentences.zh: 否则，如果你用机器人声音，他们通常直接挂断，或者你会得到非常粗鲁的挂断之类的回应。

sentences.en: So a bad tone is like, hi, my name is Nahidi Toh.
sentences.zh: 所以糟糕的语气是：嗨，我叫纳希迪·托。

sentences.en: That's a bad tone.
sentences.zh: 那是糟糕的语气。

sentences.en: And a good tone is like, oh, hi, my name is Nahidi Toh.
sentences.zh: 而好的语气是：哦，嗨，我叫纳希迪·托。

sentences.en: Well, how are you, like, stuff like that, you know.
sentences.zh: 你好吗，之类的，你知道。

sentences.en: And if I answer and I'm just like, hi, this is Taylor.
sentences.zh: 如果我接听时只是说：嗨，我是泰勒。

sentences.en: I'm calling from the Siena College Research as opposed to, hi, my name's Taylor.
sentences.zh: 我是锡耶纳学院研究所的，而不是：嗨，我叫泰勒。

sentences.en: It's a different response because if people...
sentences.zh: 反应会不同，因为如果人们……

sentences.en: Fewer people have landlines than used to be true.
sentences.zh: 拥有座机的人比过去少了。

sentences.en: People answer and they just like curse me out.
sentences.zh: 人们接听后只会咒骂我。

sentences.en: Just a lot of yelling, screaming.
sentences.zh: 就是有很多大喊大叫。

sentences.en: They'll tell you that, you know what, half off, all right?
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉你，你知道吗，打五折，好吗？

sentences.en: You know, stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Don't call me again.
sentences.zh: 别再给我打电话了。

sentences.en: This is being recorded.
sentences.zh: 这通电话正在被录音。

sentences.en: You're in big trouble if you call me again.
sentences.zh: 如果你再给我打电话，你就麻烦大了。

sentences.en: And yet it's the best option we have for reaching a representative sample of voters even still.
sentences.zh: 然而，这仍然是我们获得具有代表性的选民样本的最佳选择。

sentences.en: And how did those
sentences.zh: 那么，在你们拨打的几十万个电话中，那

sentences.en: 5,000 or so respondents out of hundreds of thousands of calls you make, how did that ensure
sentences.zh: 5000名左右的受访者，是如何确保

sentences.en: that you were doing as accurate a poll as possible, especially given the history that you just described of problems in 2016?
sentences.zh: 你们尽可能准确地进行民调的，特别是考虑到你刚才描述的2016年的历史问题？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there's really two halves what we do.
sentences.zh: 所以我们所做的工作实际上分为两部分。

sentences.en: One is that we do everything we can to make sure that the people who we get are representative.
sentences.zh: 一是我们尽一切努力确保我们获得的人群具有代表性。

sentences.en: And we go to great lengths to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们为此付出了巨大的努力。

sentences.en: For instance, we make sure that we call the right number of registered Democrats and
sentences.zh: 例如，我们会确保在每个州都拨打正确数量的民主党和共和党注册选民的电话，

sentences.en: Republicans in each state, the right number of young voters and older voters and high turnout voters and low turnout voters.
sentences.zh: 确保年轻选民、年长选民、高投票率选民和低投票率选民的比例都是正确的。

sentences.en: And then once we have our sample, we then make statistical adjustments on the back end.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们获得了样本，我们会在后端进行统计调整。

sentences.en: Despite the effort to make sure we talk to rural voters, to talk to low turnout voters, we still have too many people who have a college degree
sentences.zh: 尽管我们努力确保与农村选民和低投票率选民交谈，但我们调查对象中拥有大学学位的人数仍然过多，

sentences.en: and we have to give more weight to the people who don't have one.
sentences.zh: 因此我们必须提高那些没有学位的人的权重。

sentences.en: So you encountered the same problems as the state polls in 2016, but it sounds like you think you're coming up with some sort of a fix, some sort of an adjustment that accounts for
sentences.zh: 所以你们遇到了和2016年州级民调一样的问题，但听起来你们似乎想出了一些补救措施，某种能够解决

sentences.en: that same problem.
sentences.zh: 同样问题的调整方法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So almost all of the top pollsters out there now do this technique called weighting, where they give more weight to respondents from the underrepresented groups.
sentences.zh: 现在几乎所有顶尖的民调机构都在使用一种叫“加权”的技术，即增加代表性不足群体的受访者的权重。

sentences.zh: 然后我认为我可能会提供的第二个原型是年轻选民，他在文化议题上有一些保守观点。

sentences.en: And then I think the second archetype I might offer is a young voter who has some conservative views on cultural issues.
sentences.zh: 也许他们不喜欢政治正确文化，例如。

sentences.en: Maybe they don't like PC culture, for instance.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，你知道，伊丽莎白·沃伦，就是无法引起他们的共鸣。

sentences.en: And for some reason, you know, Elizabeth Warren, it just doesn't resonate with them very much.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了一位来自佛罗里达州的女性。

sentences.en: We spoke to one woman from Florida.
sentences.zh: 她说，引用原话，“她身上就是有某种东西让我不喜欢。”

sentences.en: She said, quote, there's just something about her that I just don't like.
sentences.zh: “我觉得她不是一个真诚的候选人。”

sentences.en: I just don't feel like she's a genuine candidate.
sentences.zh: “我觉得她的肢体语言让人反感。”

sentences.en: I find her body language to be off putting.
sentences.zh: “她非常冷漠。”

sentences.en: She's very cold.
sentences.zh: 她非常冷漠。

sentences.en: She's basically a Hillary Clinton clone.
sentences.zh: 她基本上就是希拉里·克林顿的翻版。

sentences.en: And when asked about the women running for president more generally, she said they're super unlikable.
sentences.zh: 当被问及更广泛的女性总统候选人时，她说她们非常令人反感。

sentences.en: So it actually turns out that among persuadable voters, women are a little likelier than men to say they agree that most of the women running for president are unlikable.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在摇摆选民中，女性比男性更容易认为大多数女性总统候选人令人反感。

sentences.en: That's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太有意思了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Nate, this poll would seem to deliver some pretty sobering news to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 内特，这项民调似乎给民主党人带来了一些相当严峻的消息。

sentences.en: The president is performing at a very competitive level in these six crucial swing states.
sentences.zh: 总统在这六个关键摇摆州的支持率非常有竞争力。

sentences.en: And from everything this poll just told us, the general election voter is nowhere near as far to the left as the Democratic primary voters who love, for example, Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 根据这项民调显示，大选选民的立场远没有像喜爱伊丽莎白·沃伦那样的民主党初选选民那么激进。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's a tough poll for Democrats to take right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这对民主党人来说是一份艰难的民调。

sentences.en: They might look at our data and consider other options.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会审视我们的数据，并考虑其他选择。

sentences.en: They might try and pursue a blue Texas or Georgia that maybe could make up for their weakness in these white or working class states.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会尝试争取德克萨斯州或佐治亚州，或许能弥补他们在这些白人或蓝领阶层为主的州里的劣势。

sentences.en: They might consider whether they ought to look at some of these other candidates again,
sentences.zh: 他们可能会考虑是否应该重新审视其他候选人，

sentences.en: maybe an Amy Klobuchar or a Cory Booker, who knows, someone who's closer to a compromise between the two wings of the party.
sentences.zh: 比如艾米·克洛布查尔或科里·布克，谁知道呢，也许是那些在党内两派之间更具折中色彩的人。

sentences.en: They might conclude that they have to try and change the composition of the electorate, that they may be trailing among registered voters now.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会得出结论，必须尝试改变选民构成，因为他们目前在登记选民中的支持率可能落后。

sentences.en: But after a year of registering new young and non-white voters, perhaps they could take the lead.
sentences.zh: 但经过一年对年轻选民和非白人选民的登记工作，他们或许能取得领先。

sentences.en: But with the electorate we have today and with the question of electability in mind, it seems like voters today are likeliest to support a moderate Democratic nominee.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到当前的选民构成和胜选能力问题，选民似乎最倾向于支持温和派的民主党候选人。

sentences.en: But there's a lot more to a candidate than whether you're a moderate or a liberal.
sentences.zh: 不过，候选人的考量因素远不止是温和派还是自由派。

sentences.en: Moderates aren't assured to win this election.
sentences.zh: 温和派并不能保证赢得这场选举。

sentences.en: People on the left aren't assured to lose it either.
sentences.zh: 左翼人士也不一定会输。

sentences.en: Right now, with these particular set of candidates, Elizabeth Warren fares the worst against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 目前，在这一组候选人中，伊丽莎白·沃伦在对阵特朗普总统时表现最差。

sentences.en: Joe Biden fares the beSt. And on balance, the voters who seem to be switching from candidate to candidate are concerned that the major Democratic nominees are too far to the left.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登表现最好。总的来说，那些似乎在不同候选人之间摇摆的选民担心主要的民主党候选人过于激进。

sentences.en: There's no guarantee that that's how it'll stick, but that's where things are now.
sentences.zh: 这并不保证情况会一直如此，但目前情况确实如此。

sentences.en: Nate, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 内特，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: I think Iowa is much easier to call than
sentences.zh: 我认为爱荷华州比

sentences.en: Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州更容易进行调查。

sentences.en: They're just much easier to stay on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他们更容易保持通话。

sentences.en: And really, once you say 10 minutes, like they're willing to do the 10 minutes, once it's about politics, but Michigan was a little bit harder.
sentences.zh: 一旦你说需要10分钟，他们通常愿意配合，只要是谈论政治，但密歇根州就有点难了。

sentences.en: Iowa has been a pleasure so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，爱荷华州的调查过程很愉快。

sentences.en: People are very nice, but I can't say the same for Michigan.
sentences.zh: 人们非常友善，但我不能对密歇根州说同样的话。

sentences.en: It was very difficult to do Michigan.
sentences.zh: 在密歇根州进行调查非常困难。

sentences.en: They were not willing to do the survey, and mostly they hung up on you.
sentences.zh: 他们不愿意参与调查，大多数人直接挂断了电话。

sentences.en: When I called Michigan, nobody wanted to answer the phone at all.
sentences.zh: 当我给密歇根州打电话时，根本没人愿意接听。

sentences.en: I would definitely say Iowa has been the easiest state so far.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会说爱荷华州是迄今为止最容易调查的州。

sentences.en: If you were to rank the six states in terms of friendliness, how would you rank them?
sentences.zh: 如果让你按友好程度给这六个州排名，你会怎么排？

sentences.en: Definitely Iowa, Michigan at the bottom,
sentences.zh: 绝对是爱荷华州，密歇根州垫底，

sentences.en: North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, the Trump administration formally notified the United Nations that it would withdraw
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普政府正式通知联合国，将退出

sentences.en: from the Paris Climate Accord, fulfilling a promise made by the president back in 2017.
sentences.zh: 《巴黎协定》，兑现了总统在2017年做出的承诺。

sentences.en: Under the president's plan, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据总统的计划，美国

sentences.en: will leave the agreement, the most ambitious plan to curb carbon emissions in history, on November 4th, 2020, the day after the next presidential election.
sentences.zh: 将于2020年11月4日，即下届总统大选后的第二天，退出这一旨在遏制碳排放的史上最宏大计划。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: is the first and only country to try to leave the accord amid a growing body of evidence
sentences.zh: 是第一个也是唯一一个试图退出该协定的国家，而越来越多的证据表明，

sentences.en: that climate change will lead to food shortages, worsening wildfires, and devastating floods.
sentences.zh: 气候变化将导致粮食短缺、野火加剧和毁灭性洪水。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: These are real lives, real people, with real families, and with real friends.
sentences.zh: 这些都是鲜活的生命，真实的人，有着真实的家庭和朋友。

sentences.en: And they get to go home.
sentences.zh: 他们终于可以回家了。

sentences.en: Oklahoma has carried out the largest commutation of prisoners in U.S.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州实施了美国历史上规模最大的减刑，

sentences.en: history, allowing nearly
sentences.zh: 让近

sentences.en: 500 inmates, serving time for low-level nonviolent crimes, to walk free and return to their families.
sentences.zh: 500名因轻微非暴力犯罪而服刑的囚犯重获自由，回归家庭。

sentences.en: You know, I've been out of her life for three years, but she's my hope.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我已经缺席她的生活三年了，但她是我的希望。

sentences.en: She's never given up on me.
sentences.zh: 她从未放弃过我。

sentences.en: And all I have to say is thank you.
sentences.zh: 我只想说声谢谢。

sentences.en: The commutation followed a 2016 referendum in which Oklahoma residents voted to shrink the state's prison population and downgrade many crimes, like drug possession, from felonies
sentences.zh: 此次减刑源于2016年的一次公投，当时俄克拉荷马州居民投票决定缩减州监狱人口，并将许多犯罪行为（如持有毒品）从重罪

sentences.en: to misdemeanors.
sentences.zh: 降为轻罪。

sentences.en: Many of those released on Monday had been convicted of crimes that would no longer require prison time under the state's new rules.
sentences.zh: 周一获释的许多人所犯的罪行，根据该州的新规定已不再需要入狱服刑。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: That one.
sentences.zh: 那个。

sentences.en: That one.
sentences.zh: 那个。

sentences.en: Hi, my baby.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我的宝贝。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备节日待客之道。

sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有过敏或食物禁忌？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
